purpose: Read-only option-id template for the field status/save/load/quit submenu: the four text-token / option IDs handed to the settings-dialog renderer.
logic_summary: Four int32 values { 12, 13, 14, 15 } map to the Status / Save / Load / Quit entries. The sole reader fd2_field_menu_status_save_load_quit_dispatch (@0x19DF7) copies all four 32-bit words into a local menu_options[16] stack buffer via a count-4 stride-4 loop (REP MOVSD, 32-bit elements; ESI=0x51EF5, ECX=4), then passes the buffer (alongside the paired enable/disable state template @0x53F22) to fd2_open_settings_dialog_with_slide / fd2_settings_menu_input_step. The user-selected cursor (data_fd2_ui_menu_cursor_idx 0..3) then dispatches the matching STATUS/SAVE/LOAD/QUIT branch. The source array is never written -- only the local copy is consumed.
element_semantics: [0]=12 STATUS, [1]=13 SAVE, [2]=14 LOAD, [3]=15 QUIT -- per-option text-token / option IDs consumed by the settings-dialog renderer; index position equals the dispatch cursor value 0..3.
